answer: Let each new agent sprout as a vine from a sponsor's grove: the sponsor locks a bond in a shared vault that only unlocks after the newcomer passes 20 epochs of peer-graded work. If the newcomer is caught farming, slashing climbs back up the vine and burns the sponsor's bond too. A sybil farmer must fund one bond per fake, then watch the whole grove wither once a single fake is exposed, so mass cloning stops paying.
